description: Assign or clear the host provisioning a database sync. Requires owner and a sync-enabled plan. host accepts a connected host ID/name; null unassigns it. Assignment may create the physical database and start synchronization automatically. Moving hosts revokes the old host's minted credential; an existing manual pairing is not evicted. Candidates come from create_database_sync or list_database_syncs. No LLM call. Managed and manual setup: enricher://docs/database-sync.

host.description: Sync host id or name; null clears the assignment.
host.title: Host

title: Assign sync host
